title: Elevator System
summary: Design the control logic for a bank of elevators in an office building that serves pickup requests and gets each car to its destinations.
requirements: Handle external requests (a floor button press with a direction) and internal requests (a destination button press inside a car).
Decide which elevator car should service a given request.
Move each car between floors, opening and closing doors at stops.
Support more than one elevator car operating independently in the same building.
Handle a new request for a floor that's already on a car's current route.
constraints: The building has a fixed number of floors and a fixed number of elevator cars.
Assume requests can arrive faster than a single car could possibly service them.
You don't need optimal scheduling - a reasonable dispatch strategy is enough, but explain it.
